observations: Queensland states the Aurukun Bauxite Project EIS assessment report was issued 30 April 2025 and the EIS process is concluded.
The government record identifies the assessed proponents as a Glencore/Mitsubishi joint venture, not Rio Tinto.

Queensland's public notice says the project footprint overlaps Mining Lease 7024 held by RTA Weipa Pty Ltd and the proponents must undertake a future mining-lease application process for the mine site, haul road and coastal loading facility.
